time_to_quality_definition: Two adjacent successful saved observations. No interpolation, no teacher/early stopping. All analytic evaluation after every trial finishes all optimizer steps. The 3D manufactured case has no previous full training; its explicitly looser diagnostic limits are registered before any outcome.
lifecycle: One fresh Python process per arm/seed, alternating order each seed. One pinned source revision throughout. No concurrent GPU workloads. Training/snapshot/prediction/per-process times and memory recorded separately. Independent eager/general evaluator for quality; actual trained execution/background for prediction timing.
promotion_gate: All fixed-quality gates pass on every seed in both cases; paired saved weights/metrics/counters match exactly or any differences investigated before promotion. Median training time improves at least 5 percent in each case; peak allocated memory grows no more than 10 percent. Preserve explicit general fallback and dynamic-callback auto fallback. Do not relax thresholds, omit failures or change precision after outcomes. TTO failures remain failures and do not become successful by rounding.
initial_default: general until validation; auto considered only after promotion gate
baseline_scope: Original common projection unchanged. No new feature representation, optimizer or library upgrade. boundary_rmse is face temperature error; operator error measured separately.
